draft.title: Sociocultural factors in skill learning
card: Skills develop through the people and places around a learner, not only through talent. These are called sociocultural factors.
Family can give time, money, transport and encouragement. Peers can give friendly competition, people to practise with and pressure to join in or stay out.
The sports a community values shape which skills children see, try and practise. Cultural beliefs about who should play a sport can open or limit chances.
Access to fields, courts, pools and equipment decides how often a learner can practise. Quality coaching gives instruction and feedback that help skills improve.
draft.remember: Skills grow where a learner has people, opportunity and good instruction around them.

a.q: Which situation shows access to facilities affecting skill development?
opts: A teen in a remote town has no pool, so rarely swims
A teen's friends tease her for joining a netball team
A teen's parents drive him to training and pay fees
A teen's town holds a yearly festival based on footy
a.why: With no pool nearby, the teenager cannot practise swimming often, so access to facilities limits skill growth. The friends' teasing is a peer factor, not a facility one.
a.clue: Look for the option about a place or equipment to practise in.

b.q: Priya's parents work late, so she cannot get to training. Her coach is highly qualified and her club has good courts. Which factor is limiting her skill development most?
opts: Family support, because she lacks transport to training
Coaching, because her coach gives poor instruction
Facilities, because the club courts are not good enough
Peers, because her teammates put pressure on her
b.why: Her coach and courts are described as good, so they are not the problem. Her family cannot get her to training, so family support limits how often she can practise. Facilities are tempting, but the courts exist and are good.
b.clue: Check which factors the scenario describes as good, then find the one that is not.

a.best: A teen in a remote town has no pool, so rarely swims

b.best: Family support, because she lacks transport to training
